item.title: Dining Services employees slept on army cots in Ratty, V-Dub during blizzard
item.description: As a record-breaking 37.9 inches of snow fell on Providence on Sunday night, staff members from Dining Services slept on army cots in the Sharpe Refectory and Verney-Woolley Dining Hall.
